name: gated_attention_decode_qkv_dim4608_n_kv_heads1_head_dim256
description: Qwen3.5 full-attention decode on one rank, between qkv_proj and o_proj, one token per row. projected_qkv holds each query head's query then its output gate, then the KV heads' keys, then their values. Q and K are RMS-normalized per head with weight 1 + norm weight and rounded to BF16; each head's first 64 channels take NeoX RoPE, rounded to BF16, whose frequency f in [0, 32) reads positions[1] when f % 3 == 1 and f < 33, positions[2] when f % 3 == 2 and f < 30, else positions[0], in cos_sin_cache's row of 32 cosines then 32 sines. Each row writes its K and V, cast to E4M3FN, at its cache_locations slot of key_cache and value_cache; rows sharing a slot leave one of their values there. Query head h then attends, through KV head h // (n_heads // n_kv_heads), the written slots kv_indices[kv_indptr[r]:kv_indptr[r + 1]] with scores q . k * scale; the softmax-weighted sum of their values is rounded to BF16, multiplied by sigmoid of the gate and rounded to BF16. Unwritten slots and all other inputs are preserved.

n_tokens.description: Decode rows: one token each, padding rows included.

qkv_dim.description: qkv_proj's output width on this rank.

head_dim.description: Query, key and value head width.

attention_width.description: Channels of a row: n_heads * head_dim.

projected_qkv.description: qkv_proj's output: each query head's query then gate, then keys, then values.

q_norm_weight.description: Query RMSNorm weight, applied as 1 + weight.

k_norm_weight.description: Key RMSNorm weight, applied as 1 + weight.

positions.description: Each row's temporal, height and width positions.

cos_sin_cache.description: Per position, the 32 rotary cosines then the 32 sines.

kv_indptr.description: Where each row's slots start in kv_indices, then where the last row's end.

kv_indices.description: The pool slots each row attends, row after row.

gated.description: Each query head's gated attention, the heads side by side: o_proj's input.

# Created by OpenAI
"""CDNA4 paged attention with a two-buffer gather/compute pipeline.

One producer owns (row, KV head, split); one finisher owns four query heads.
Every invocation writes all split records: BF16 scaled numerators and FP32
(maximum, denominator). The finish rounds attention to BF16 before the FP32
sigmoid/product. Lengths, page mappings, scales, Q and gates remain live.
"""
from typing import NamedTuple

import torch
import triton
from triton.experimental import gluon
from triton.experimental.gluon import language as gl

_BLOCK_TOKENS = gl.constexpr(64)
_LOG2E = gl.constexpr(1.4426950408889634)
_LOAD_LAYOUT = gl.BlockedLayout([1, 16], [4, 16], [4, 1], [1, 0])
_MMA_LAYOUT = gl.amd.AMDMFMALayout(
    version=4, instr_shape=[16, 16, 32], transposed=True, warps_per_cta=[1, 4])


class _Config(NamedTuple):
    """Capture-stable geometry and tuning, never values or live lengths."""

    rows: int
    heads: int
    kv_heads: int
    dim: int
    query_strides: tuple[int, int]
    key_strides: tuple[int, int]
    value_strides: tuple[int, int]
    splits: int
    finish_heads: int
    value_phases: int
    block_dim: int
    has_scale: bool
    async_loads: bool
    narrow_offsets: bool
    index_count: int


@gluon.jit
def _cache_policy(length, C: gl.constexpr):
    """K/V retention bands use the live byte footprint, never capacity."""
    footprint: gl.constexpr = C.rows * C.kv_heads * C.dim * 2
    if C.rows == 256:
        return (length <= (256 * 1024 * 1024) // footprint,
                length <= (768 * 1024 * 1024) // footprint)
    lower: gl.constexpr = ((96 if C.rows == 128 else 128) * 1024 * 1024) // footprint
    return ((length >= lower) & (length <= (768 * 1024 * 1024) // footprint),
            (length >= lower) & (length <= (256 * 1024 * 1024) // footprint))


@gluon.jit
def _split_bounds(length, part, C: gl.constexpr):
    # Keep five fixed records for M128, using four above 22 live B64 tiles.
    B: gl.constexpr = _BLOCK_TOKENS
    chunk = gl.cdiv(length, B * C.splits) * B
    if C.rows == 128:
        chunk = gl.where(length > 22 * B, gl.cdiv(length, B * 4) * B, chunk)
    lo = part * chunk
    return lo, gl.minimum(lo + chunk, length)


@gluon.jit
def _softmax_step(q, key, maximum, denominator, acc, scale, remaining):
    # Preserve natural-log scores/maxima; evaluate centered exponentials directly.
    ml: gl.constexpr = acc.type.layout
    scores = gl.amd.cdna4.mfma(
        q, key, gl.full((q.shape[0], key.shape[1]), 0, gl.float32, layout=ml))
    scores = scores * scale
    tokens = gl.arange(0, key.shape[1], layout=gl.SliceLayout(0, ml))
    valid = tokens[None, :] < remaining
    scores = gl.where(valid, scores, -float('inf'))
    new_max = gl.maximum(maximum, gl.max(scores, 1))
    alpha = gl.exp2((maximum - new_max) * _LOG2E)
    p = gl.where(valid, gl.exp2((scores - new_max[:, None]) * _LOG2E), 0.0)
    denominator = denominator * alpha + gl.sum(p, 1)
    acc = acc * alpha[:, None]
    return p, new_max, denominator, acc


@gluon.jit
def _copy_tile(tile, ptr, token_mask, full, CACHE: gl.constexpr):
    # The common full-tile branch avoids the masked copy's zero-fill overhead.
    if full:
        gl.amd.cdna4.async_copy.global_load_to_shared(
            tile, ptr, other=0.0, cache_modifier=CACHE)
    else:
        gl.amd.cdna4.async_copy.global_load_to_shared(
            tile, ptr, token_mask, other=0.0, cache_modifier=CACHE)


@gluon.jit
def _copy_by_policy(tile, ptr, mask, local_cache):
    if local_cache:
        gl.amd.cdna4.async_copy.global_load_to_shared(
            tile, ptr, mask, other=0.0, cache_modifier=".ca")
    else:
        gl.amd.cdna4.async_copy.global_load_to_shared(
            tile, ptr, mask, other=0.0, cache_modifier=".cg")


@gluon.jit
def _stage_tile(tile, PTR, slots, group, base, end,
                STRIDES: gl.constexpr, C: gl.constexpr, local_cache):
    ll: gl.constexpr = _LOAD_LAYOUT
    shared: gl.constexpr = tile.type.layout
    tt = gl.arange(0, tile.shape[0], layout=gl.SliceLayout(1, ll))
    dd = gl.arange(0, tile.shape[1], layout=gl.SliceLayout(0, ll))
    phase = (tt[:, None] // shared.per_phase) % shared.max_phase
    swizzled_dim = dd[None, :] ^ (phase * shared.vec)
    # Unsigned narrowing is essential: the production FP8 pool exceeds 2 GiB.
    if C.narrow_offsets:
        offsets = slots.to(gl.uint32)[:, None] * STRIDES[0] + swizzled_dim
    else:
        offsets = slots.to(gl.int64)[:, None] * STRIDES[0] + swizzled_dim
    offsets = gl.max_contiguous(gl.multiple_of(offsets, [1, 16]), [1, 16])
    ptr = PTR + group * STRIDES[1] + offsets.to(gl.uint64)
    flat = tile._reinterpret(layout=gl.SwizzledSharedLayout(1, 1, 1, order=[1, 0]))
    if C.rows == 128:
        # M128 benefits from testing fullness before selecting its cache hint.
        # The unmasked hot path does not need any per-token predicates.
        if base + tile.shape[0] <= end:
            _copy_by_policy(flat, ptr, None, local_cache)
        else:
            _copy_by_policy(flat, ptr, base + tt[:, None] < end, local_cache)
    else:
        if local_cache:
            _copy_tile(flat, ptr, base + tt[:, None] < end, base + tile.shape[0] <= end, ".ca")
        else:
            _copy_tile(flat, ptr, base + tt[:, None] < end, base + tile.shape[0] <= end, ".cg")
    gl.amd.cdna4.async_copy.commit_group()


@gluon.jit
def _read_tile(tile, PTR, slots, group, base, end,
               STRIDES: gl.constexpr, C: gl.constexpr, TRANSPOSE: gl.constexpr):
    operand: gl.constexpr = gl.DotOperandLayout(1, _MMA_LAYOUT, 8)
    if tile is not None:
        # K and V have disjoint storage. The V wait releases prior K readers;
        # the next K wait releases prior V readers before either buffer reuse.
        gl.amd.cdna4.async_copy.wait_group(0)
        if TRANSPOSE:
            raw = tile.permute((1, 0)).load(operand)
        else:
            raw = tile.load(operand)
    else:
        ll: gl.constexpr = _LOAD_LAYOUT
        tt = gl.arange(0, slots.shape[0], layout=gl.SliceLayout(1, ll))
        dd = gl.arange(0, C.block_dim, layout=gl.SliceLayout(0, ll))
        if C.narrow_offsets:
            offset = (slots.to(gl.uint32) * STRIDES[0]).to(gl.uint64)
        else:
            offset = slots.to(gl.int64) * STRIDES[0]
        ptr = PTR + offset[:, None] + group * STRIDES[1] + dd[None, :]
        raw = gl.load(ptr, (base + tt[:, None] < end) & (dd[None, :] < C.dim), 0.0)
        if TRANSPOSE:
            raw = raw.permute((1, 0))
    return gl.convert_layout(raw, operand).to(gl.bfloat16)


@gluon.jit
def _page_indices(IX, offsets, valid, COUNT: gl.constexpr):
    # Lookahead indices are allocation-bounded; only live masks authorize KV.
    if COUNT > 0 and COUNT * IX.dtype.element_ty.primitive_bitwidth // 8 < 2**31:
        return gl.amd.cdna4.buffer_load(IX, gl.minimum(offsets, COUNT - 1)).to(gl.int64)
    else:
        return gl.load(IX + offsets, valid, 0).to(gl.int64)


@gluon.jit
def _attention_partials(Q, K, V, IP, IX, KS, VS, PART, STAT,
                        SCALE: gl.constexpr, C: gl.constexpr):
    B: gl.constexpr = _BLOCK_TOKENS
    row = gl.program_id(0)
    group = 0 if C.kv_heads == 1 else gl.program_id(1)
    part = gl.program_id(2)
    G: gl.constexpr = C.heads // C.kv_heads
    gl.static_assert(G == 8)
    HM: gl.constexpr = 16
    ll: gl.constexpr = _LOAD_LAYOUT
    ml: gl.constexpr = _MMA_LAYOUT
    al: gl.constexpr = gl.DotOperandLayout(0, ml, 8)
    hs = gl.arange(0, HM, layout=gl.SliceLayout(1, ll))
    ds = gl.arange(0, C.block_dim, layout=gl.SliceLayout(0, ll))
    q = gl.load(Q + row * C.query_strides[0]
        + (group * G + hs[:, None]) * C.query_strides[1] + ds[None, :],
        (hs[:, None] < G) & (ds[None, :] < C.dim), 0)
    start = gl.load(IP + row)
    length = gl.load(IP + row + 1) - start
    if C.has_scale:
        sk = gl.load(KS)
        sv = gl.load(VS)
    else:
        sk = 1.0
        sv = 1.0
    sk = sk * SCALE
    cache_key, cache_value = _cache_policy(length, C)
    lo, hi = _split_bounds(length, part, C)
    ts = gl.arange(0, B, layout=gl.SliceLayout(1, ll))
    maximum = gl.full((HM,), -float('inf'), gl.float32, layout=gl.SliceLayout(1, ml))
    denominator = gl.full((HM,), 0, gl.float32, layout=gl.SliceLayout(1, ml))
    acc = gl.full((HM, C.block_dim), 0, gl.float32, layout=ml)
    if C.async_loads:
        shared: gl.constexpr = gl.SwizzledSharedLayout(16, 1, 8, order=[1, 0])
        key_tile = gl.allocate_shared_memory(K.dtype.element_ty, (B, C.block_dim), shared)
        v_shared: gl.constexpr = gl.SwizzledSharedLayout(16, 1, C.value_phases, order=[1, 0])
        value_tile = gl.allocate_shared_memory(V.dtype.element_ty, (B, C.block_dim), v_shared)
        pos = lo + ts
        slots = _page_indices(IX, start + pos, pos < hi, C.index_count)
        if lo < hi:
            _stage_tile(key_tile, K, slots, group, lo, hi, C.key_strides, C, cache_key)
    else:
        key_tile = None
        value_tile = None
    # Redistribute Q while the first asynchronous K transfer is in flight.
    q = gl.convert_layout(q, al)
    # K read -> V copy / softmax -> V read -> next K copy / PV.
    for base in range(lo, hi, B):
        pos = base + ts
        if not C.async_loads:
            slots = _page_indices(IX, start + pos, pos < hi, C.index_count)
        key = _read_tile(key_tile, K, slots, group, base, hi, C.key_strides, C, True)
        if C.async_loads:
            next_pos = base + B + ts
            next_slots = _page_indices(IX, start + next_pos, next_pos < hi, C.index_count)
            _stage_tile(value_tile, V, slots, group, base, hi, C.value_strides, C, cache_value)
        p, maximum, denominator, acc = _softmax_step(
            q, key, maximum, denominator, acc, sk, hi - base)
        value = _read_tile(value_tile, V, slots, group, base, hi, C.value_strides, C, False)
        if C.async_loads:
            if base + B < hi:
                _stage_tile(key_tile, K, next_slots, group, base + B, hi,
                            C.key_strides, C, cache_key)
            slots = next_slots
        acc = gl.amd.cdna4.mfma(gl.convert_layout(p.to(gl.bfloat16), al), value, acc)
    mh = gl.arange(0, HM, layout=gl.SliceLayout(1, ml))
    md = gl.arange(0, C.block_dim, layout=gl.SliceLayout(0, ml))
    # Neutral records (0, -inf, 0) must overwrite old graph-replay scratch too.
    record = (row * C.heads + group * G + mh) * C.splits + part
    gl.store(PART + record[:, None] * C.dim + md[None, :], acc * sv,
             (mh[:, None] < G) & (md[None, :] < C.dim))
    gl.store(STAT + record * 2, maximum, mh < G)
    gl.store(STAT + record * 2 + 1, denominator, mh < G)


@gluon.jit
def _finish_gate(PART, STAT, GATE, OUT, GS: gl.constexpr, C: gl.constexpr):
    H: gl.constexpr = C.heads
    D: gl.constexpr = C.dim
    S: gl.constexpr = C.splits
    BD: gl.constexpr = C.block_dim
    BH: gl.constexpr = C.finish_heads
    row = gl.program_id(0)
    head = gl.program_id(1) * BH
    gl.static_assert(S == 5)
    PS: gl.constexpr = 8
    VEC: gl.constexpr = 2 if S == 2 else 4
    ll: gl.constexpr = gl.BlockedLayout([1, 1, VEC], [1, 1, 64], [BH, 1, 1], [2, 1, 0])
    sl: gl.constexpr = gl.SliceLayout(2, ll)
    hh = head + gl.arange(0, BH, layout=gl.SliceLayout(1, sl))
    ss = gl.arange(0, PS, layout=gl.SliceLayout(0, sl))
    dd = gl.arange(0, BD, layout=gl.SliceLayout(0, gl.SliceLayout(1, ll)))
    record = (row * H + hh[:, None]) * S + ss[None, :]
    valid = (hh[:, None] < H) & (ss[None, :] < S)
    m = gl.load(STAT + record * 2, valid, -float('inf'))
    z = gl.load(STAT + record * 2 + 1, valid, 0.0)
    mx = gl.max(m, 1)
    weight = gl.exp2((m - mx[:, None]) * _LOG2E)
    den = gl.sum(z * weight, 1)
    val = gl.load(PART + record[:, :, None] * D + dd[None, None, :],
        valid[:, :, None] & (dd[None, None, :] < D), 0.0)
    ol: gl.constexpr = gl.SliceLayout(1, ll)
    den = gl.convert_layout(den, gl.SliceLayout(1, ol))
    # The gate sees rounded BF16 attention, but its sigmoid stays FP32.
    attention = (gl.sum(val * weight[:, :, None], 1) / den[:, None]).to(gl.bfloat16).to(gl.float32)
    oh = head + gl.arange(0, BH, layout=gl.SliceLayout(1, ol))
    od = gl.arange(0, BD, layout=gl.SliceLayout(0, ol))
    gate = gl.load(GATE + row * GS + oh[:, None] * D + od[None, :],
                   (oh[:, None] < H) & (od[None, :] < D), 0).to(gl.float32)
    out = attention * (1.0 / (1.0 + gl.exp(-gate)))
    gl.store(OUT + (row * H + oh[:, None]) * D + od[None, :], out,
             (oh[:, None] < H) & (od[None, :] < D))


def _fits_u32_offsets(cache: torch.Tensor) -> bool:
    token_stride, head_stride = cache.stride(0), cache.stride(1)
    extent = ((cache.shape[0] - 1) * token_stride
              + (cache.shape[1] - 1) * head_stride + cache.shape[2])
    return token_stride >= 0 and head_stride >= 0 and extent <= 2**32


def _launch_config(query, key_cache, value_cache, has_scale, index_count):
    rows, heads, dim = query.shape
    # Static tuning lives here; live-length tuning is in the two policy helpers.
    splits = 5 if rows < 192 else 4 if rows < 256 else 2
    async_loads = (
        dim == 256
        and key_cache.dtype in (torch.float8_e4m3fn, torch.float8_e4m3fnuz)
        and all(t.stride(0) % 16 == 0 and t.stride(1) % 16 == 0
                and t.storage_offset() % 16 == 0 for t in (key_cache, value_cache)))
    return _Config(
        rows=rows, heads=heads, kv_heads=key_cache.shape[1], dim=dim,
        query_strides=query.stride()[:2], key_strides=key_cache.stride()[:2],
        value_strides=value_cache.stride()[:2],
        splits=splits, block_dim=max(32, triton.next_power_of_2(dim)),
        finish_heads=4,
        value_phases=4 if rows in (136, 192) else 8,
        has_scale=has_scale, async_loads=async_loads, index_count=index_count,
        narrow_offsets=_fits_u32_offsets(key_cache) and _fits_u32_offsets(value_cache),
    )


def paged_attention_output_gate(
    query: torch.Tensor, key_cache: torch.Tensor, value_cache: torch.Tensor,
    kv_indptr: torch.Tensor, kv_indices: torch.Tensor, gate: torch.Tensor,
    *, scale: float, max_context: int,
    k_scale: torch.Tensor | None = None, v_scale: torch.Tensor | None = None,
    output: torch.Tensor,
) -> torch.Tensor:
    """max_context is capacity, not a live row length or dispatch input."""
    config = _launch_config(
        query, key_cache, value_cache, k_scale is not None, kv_indices.numel())
    rows, heads, dim, splits = config.rows, config.heads, config.dim, config.splits
    partial = torch.empty((rows, heads, splits, dim), device=query.device, dtype=torch.bfloat16)
    stats = torch.empty((rows, heads, splits, 2), device=query.device, dtype=torch.float32)
    _attention_partials[(rows, config.kv_heads, splits)](
        query, key_cache, value_cache, kv_indptr, kv_indices,
        query if k_scale is None else k_scale, query if v_scale is None else v_scale,
        partial, stats, scale, config, num_warps=4)
    _finish_gate[(rows, triton.cdiv(heads, config.finish_heads))](
        partial, stats, gate, output, gate.stride(0), config, num_warps=config.finish_heads)
    return output

# Created by OpenAI
"""Qwen3.5 gated attention decode with a BF16 output for MI355X (gfx950), scheduled for
128 rows.

prologue.py RMS-normalizes Q and K, applies the interleaved mRoPE and writes each row's FP8
key and value slots; attention.py then attends each query head over its paged FP8 cache in
split partitions and merges them with the output gate into the BF16 rows o_proj takes. Both
read unit KV scales.
"""

import functools

import torch

from .attention import paged_attention_output_gate
from .prologue import fused_attention_qk_norm_rope_kv_cache


@functools.cache
def _unit_scale(device):
    """The FP32 KV scale both kernels read: the pools hold unscaled values."""
    return torch.ones(1, dtype=torch.float32, device=device)


def run(
    *,
    projected_qkv,
    q_norm_weight,
    k_norm_weight,
    positions,
    cos_sin_cache,
    cache_locations,
    key_cache,
    value_cache,
    kv_indptr,
    kv_indices,
    eps,
    scale,
    gated,
):
    unit = _unit_scale(projected_qkv.device)
    query, gate, _, _, _, _ = fused_attention_qk_norm_rope_kv_cache(
        projected_qkv,
        q_norm_weight,
        k_norm_weight,
        positions,
        cos_sin_cache,
        cache_locations,
        key_cache,
        value_cache,
        eps=eps,
        rotary_dim=64,
        k_scale=unit,
        v_scale=unit,
        mrope_section=(11, 11, 10),
    )
    paged_attention_output_gate(
        query,
        key_cache,
        value_cache,
        kv_indptr,
        kv_indices,
        gate,
        scale=scale,
        max_context=key_cache.shape[0],
        k_scale=unit,
        v_scale=unit,
        output=gated,
    )

# Created by OpenAI
"""MI355 wave-local Q/K norm, mRoPE, and replay-safe FP8 cache updates."""
import torch
from triton.experimental import gluon
from triton.experimental.gluon import language as gl


@gluon.constexpr_function
def _axis_mask(section, remainder):
    return sum(1 << i for i in range(32) if i % 3 == remainder and i < 3 * section)


@gluon.jit
def _head_transform(
    Packed, Weight, Positions, CosSin, token, head,
    HEADS: gl.constexpr, GROUP: gl.constexpr, EPS: gl.constexpr,
    POS_STRIDE: gl.constexpr, SECTIONS: gl.constexpr,
):
    layout: gl.constexpr = gl.BlockedLayout(
        [1, 2], [GROUP, 64 // GROUP], [1, 1], [1, 0])
    col = gl.arange(0, 256, layout=gl.SliceLayout(0, layout))
    packed_row = token * ((HEADS + 1) * 512) + head * 512
    weight = gl.load(Weight + col).to(gl.float32)
    source = gl.load(Packed + packed_row[:, None] + col[None, :]).to(gl.float32)
    variance = gl.sum(source * source, 1) / 256.0
    # The BF16 boundary precedes RoPE, even though it stays in registers.
    norm = (source * gl.rsqrt(variance[:, None] + EPS) *
            (1.0 + weight[None, :])).to(gl.bfloat16)
    nf = norm.to(gl.float32)
    if GROUP == 4:
        pairs = gl.permute(gl.reshape(norm, (GROUP, 4, 2, 32)), (0, 1, 3, 2))
        left, right = gl.split(pairs)
        partner = gl.convert_layout(
            gl.reshape(gl.permute(gl.join(right, left), (0, 1, 3, 2)),
                       (GROUP, 256)), layout).to(gl.float32)
    else:
        partner = gl.gather(nf, (col ^ 32)[None, :] +
                            gl.full((GROUP, 256), 0, gl.int32, layout), 1)
    frequency = col % 32
    height = ((gl.full((), _axis_mask(SECTIONS[1], 1), gl.uint32) >> frequency) & 1) != 0
    width = ((gl.full((), _axis_mask(SECTIONS[2], 2), gl.uint32) >> frequency) & 1) != 0
    text_pos = gl.load(Positions + token).to(gl.int32)
    height_pos = gl.load(Positions + POS_STRIDE + token).to(gl.int32)
    width_pos = gl.load(Positions + 2 * POS_STRIDE + token).to(gl.int32)
    pos = gl.where(height[None, :], height_pos[:, None],
                   gl.where(width[None, :], width_pos[:, None], text_pos[:, None]))
    cosine = gl.amd.cdna4.buffer_load(
        CosSin, (pos * 64 + frequency[None, :]).to(gl.int32)).to(gl.float32)
    sine = gl.amd.cdna4.buffer_load(
        CosSin, (pos * 64 + frequency[None, :] + 32).to(gl.int32)).to(gl.float32)
    rotated = gl.where(col[None, :] < 32, nf * cosine - partner * sine,
                       nf * cosine + partner * sine)
    result = gl.where(col[None, :] < 64, rotated.to(gl.bfloat16), norm)
    auxiliary = gl.load(Packed + packed_row[:, None] + 256 + col[None, :])
    return result, auxiliary


@gluon.jit
def _attention_prologue(
    Packed, QWeight, KWeight, Positions, CosSin, Locations,
    KCache, VCache, Query, Gate, Key, KScale, VScale,
    ROWS: gl.constexpr, HEADS: gl.constexpr, EPS: gl.constexpr,
    POS_STRIDE: gl.constexpr, SECTIONS: gl.constexpr, K_GROUP: gl.constexpr,
    Q_CACHE: gl.constexpr, G_CACHE: gl.constexpr,
):
    pid = gl.program_id(0).to(gl.uint32)
    if pid < ROWS // K_GROUP:
        k_layout: gl.constexpr = gl.BlockedLayout(
            [1, 2], [K_GROUP, 64 // K_GROUP], [1, 1], [1, 0])
        k_token = pid * K_GROUP + gl.arange(
            0, K_GROUP, layout=gl.SliceLayout(1, k_layout)).to(gl.uint32)
        k_head = gl.full((K_GROUP,), HEADS, gl.uint32, gl.SliceLayout(1, k_layout))
        # Device scales and locations remain live across graph replays.
        ks = gl.load(KScale).to(gl.float32)
        vs = gl.load(VScale).to(gl.float32)
        key, value = _head_transform(
            Packed, KWeight, Positions, CosSin, k_token, k_head,
            HEADS, K_GROUP, EPS, POS_STRIDE, SECTIONS)
        k_col = gl.arange(0, 256, layout=gl.SliceLayout(0, k_layout))
        if K_GROUP == 2:
            # Unsigned offsets cover this FP8 cache's entire >2-GiB span.
            slot = gl.load(Locations + k_token).to(gl.uint32)
        else:
            slot = gl.load(Locations + k_token).to(gl.int64)
        k_offset = k_token[:, None] * 256 + k_col[None, :]
        gl.store(Key + k_offset, key)
        if ks == 1.0 and vs == 1.0:
            scaled_key, scaled_value = key, value
        else:
            scaled_key = gl.div_rn(key.to(gl.float32), ks).to(gl.bfloat16)
            scaled_value = gl.div_rn(value.to(gl.float32), vs).to(gl.bfloat16)
        cache_offset = slot[:, None] * 256 + k_col[None, :]
        gl.store(KCache + cache_offset, scaled_key)
        gl.store(VCache + cache_offset, scaled_value)
    else:
        q_layout: gl.constexpr = gl.BlockedLayout([1, 2], [4, 16], [1, 1], [1, 0])
        row = gl.arange(0, 4, layout=gl.SliceLayout(1, q_layout)).to(gl.uint32)
        index = (pid - ROWS // K_GROUP) * 4 + row
        token, head = index // HEADS, index % HEADS
        query, gate = _head_transform(
            Packed, QWeight, Positions, CosSin, token, head,
            HEADS, 4, EPS, POS_STRIDE, SECTIONS)
        col = gl.arange(0, 256, layout=gl.SliceLayout(0, q_layout))
        output_offset = (token[:, None] * HEADS + head[:, None]) * 256 + col[None, :]
        gl.store(Query + output_offset, query, cache_modifier=Q_CACHE)
        gl.store(Gate + output_offset, gate, cache_modifier=G_CACHE)


def _allocate_outputs(packed, rows, heads):
    shapes = ((rows, heads, 256), (rows, heads * 256), (rows, 1, 256))
    if rows == 128:
        return tuple(torch.empty(shape, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=packed.device)
                     for shape in shapes)
    gap = 4096
    qs, ks = rows * heads * 256, rows * 256
    sizes = (qs, qs, ks)
    offsets = (0, qs + gap, 2 * qs + 2 * gap)
    storage = torch.empty((2 * qs + ks + 2 * gap,),
                          dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=packed.device)
    return tuple(storage[offset:offset + size].view(shape)
                 for shape, size, offset in zip(shapes, sizes, offsets))


def fused_attention_qk_norm_rope_kv_cache(
    projected_qkv_gate: torch.Tensor,
    q_norm_weight: torch.Tensor,
    k_norm_weight: torch.Tensor,
    positions: torch.Tensor,
    cos_sin_cache: torch.Tensor,
    cache_locations: torch.Tensor,
    key_cache: torch.Tensor,
    value_cache: torch.Tensor,
    *,
    eps: float = 1.0e-6,
    rotary_dim: int = 64,
    k_scale: torch.Tensor | None = None,
    v_scale: torch.Tensor | None = None,
    mrope_section: tuple[int, int, int] | None = None,
) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
    rows, width = projected_qkv_gate.shape
    assert rows in (128, 136, 192, 256) and width == 4608 and rotary_dim == 64
    assert key_cache.dtype is value_cache.dtype is torch.float8_e4m3fn
    assert k_scale is not None and v_scale is not None and mrope_section is not None
    assert cos_sin_cache.numel() < 2**30 and key_cache.numel() < 2**32
    heads = (width - 512) // 512
    query, gate, key = _allocate_outputs(projected_qkv_gate, rows, heads)
    # V is unchanged; its FP8 cache conversion still runs on every invocation.
    value = projected_qkv_gate[:, heads * 512 + 256:].view(rows, 1, 256)
    k_group = 2 if rows == 192 else 1
    _attention_prologue[(rows // k_group + rows * heads // 4,)](
        projected_qkv_gate, q_norm_weight, k_norm_weight, positions, cos_sin_cache,
        cache_locations, key_cache, value_cache, query, gate, key, k_scale, v_scale,
        ROWS=rows, HEADS=heads, EPS=eps, POS_STRIDE=positions.stride(0),
        SECTIONS=mrope_section, K_GROUP=k_group,
        Q_CACHE="" if rows == 192 else ".cs",
        G_CACHE="" if rows == 128 else ".cs", num_warps=1,
    )
    return query, gate, key, value, key_cache, value_cache
